name: Procedural animation layer: look-at and foot placement
body: On top of the sampled pose: head and neck look-at toward a target with clamped angles and smoothing (the companion looks at the player, the player looks where the camera leads), then two-bone foot IK that plants feet on uneven ground using the physics world. Look-at first; foot placement only if look-at lands cleanly.

comments.text: Look-at is done (D-126..D-132). Foot placement moved to foot-placement-two-bone-ik-on-slopes-and-stairs and footslide-correction-by-stride-matching.
